pre_condition: value is an arbitrary input. key is a non-empty string identifying the field for error messages. source is a provenance string for error messages.
post_condition: Raises ValueError whose message text contains source and key when value is not of list type. Raises ValueError whose message text contains source, key, and a 1-based index when any element of value is not of string type. Otherwise returns a tuple of the non-empty strings derived from the elements of value, preserving element order; elements that yield an empty string after label validation are excluded from the result.
